name: PickPair – Upsells, Cross-sells, Order Bumps, One-Click Upsells & Related Products for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
PickPair is a complete WooCommerce upsell and cross sell plugin that turns single-item orders into bigger ones. It combines Frequently Bought Together bundles, related products, cart upsells, checkout order bumps, one-click upsells, and post-purchase offers into one plugin — so you don’t need five separate tools to grow your Average Order Value.

Most stores lose easy revenue simply because the right offer was never shown at the right time. A customer buying a phone rarely thinks to add a case or charger on their own — they need to be shown it. PickPair shows that offer automatically, on the product page, in the cart, at checkout, and again after the order is placed, so every visitor sees something worth adding to their order.

Key Benefits of Using PickPair for WooCommerce Upsells

  • Increase your store’s Average Order Value with Frequently Bought Together bundles, cart upsells, and checkout order bumps.
  • Show product bundles and related products on the product page, so customers buy matching items together.
  • Add one-click checkout upsells, cart cross-sells, and order bumps without writing any code.
  • Display post-purchase upsells on the Thank You page to turn one order into a second sale.
  • Bring customers back with an automatic next-order coupon — a simple way to boost repeat sales.
  • Works with both classic WooCommerce pages and the newer WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.
  • Set up in minutes from your WordPress dashboard — no coding or design skills needed.

Once an offer is set up, PickPair keeps showing it to the right customers on its own, with no daily work needed from you. Every campaign tracks its own views, clicks, and revenue, so you always know which upsells and cross-sells are actually growing your sales.

Visit the PickPair website to see everything it can do, check the full feature list, or see pricing and plans.

Every Feature, In Full

  • Shows “Frequently Bought Together” offers on the product page — like Amazon does — so customers can add matching products with one click.
  • Shows extra products in the cart (cart upsells and cross-sells) so customers add more before they pay.
  • Shows order bumps at checkout — small extra items customers can add with just one checkbox, right before payment.
  • Shows a pop-up offer when a customer clicks “Add to Cart”, suggesting one more item.
  • Shows a special offer on the Thank You page after the order is placed, so the customer buys again right away.
  • Shows a free shipping bar in the cart (example: “Add $10 more for free shipping!”) so customers spend a little more.
  • Sends a coupon for the customer’s next order automatically, to bring them back to your store again.
  • Lets you choose who sees each offer — by product, category, cart amount, customer type, or past orders — so offers always feel useful, not random.
  • Shows easy reports on your dashboard — how many people saw each offer, clicked it, and how much extra money it made you.

How “Frequently Bought Together” Works

  1. A customer opens a product page in your store.
  2. PickPair shows other products that go well with it, in a simple box.
  3. The customer picks the ones they want by ticking a checkbox.
  4. All the selected products get added to the cart together, with just one click — and a special bundle price if you have set one.

You can also:

  • Give a discount for the bundle — a percentage off, a fixed amount off, or one fixed bundle price.
  • Add extra items to a single product or to the whole cart (called Product Add-ons and Cart Add-ons) — like gift wrapping or a warranty.
  • Choose exactly which products should be shown together, instead of leaving it only to guesswork.
  • Stop customers from buying a bundle if one item is out of stock.
  • Choose whether offer prices use the sale price or the normal price.

Offers in the Cart, at Checkout, and After Purchase

Once someone has already added something to their cart, it is much easier to sell them one more item. PickPair uses every step after that to offer something useful:

  • Cart offers — related products shown right inside the cart page.
  • Checkout order bumps — small, simple add-ons a customer can accept with one click before paying, like gift wrap or extra warranty.
  • Pop-up offers — a friendly pop-up window shown the moment a product is added to the cart.
  • Thank You page offers — one more deal shown right after the order is placed, when the customer is happiest.
  • Free shipping bar — encourages customers to spend a little more instead of leaving with a small order.
  • Fast cart updates — offers are added to the cart without reloading the page, so it feels quick and smooth.

Show the Right Offer to the Right Customer

Not every offer should be shown to every customer. With PickPair’s Smart Rules, you decide who sees what:

  • Show an offer only for certain products or categories.
  • Show an offer only when the cart total is above a certain amount.
  • Show different offers to logged-in customers, guests, or specific customer types.
  • Show a different offer to someone who has ordered from you before.
  • Choose where on the page each offer appears — top, bottom, or another spot you pick.

Bring Customers Back With a “Next Order” Coupon

Getting a customer to buy from you a second time costs much less than finding a brand-new customer. PickPair’s Next Order Coupon feature sends a discount coupon automatically for the customer’s next purchase. You can set how long the coupon lasts, how it looks, and when it should be sent — a simple way to turn a one-time buyer into a repeat customer.

See Your Results Clearly

Every offer inside PickPair keeps track of its own results, so you always know what is working:

  • How much extra money each offer has earned you.
  • How many people saw the offer and how many clicked it.
  • How many people actually bought because of it.
  • A simple list of all your offers, with search and filters, so it is easy to manage even if you run many offers at once.

Fast and Simple for Any Store

PickPair only loads on the pages where an offer is shown, so it does not slow your website down. It looks good on phones, tablets, and computers, and works well with popular speed plugins like WP Rocket and LiteSpeed Cache.

PickPair works for every type of WooCommerce store:

  • Electronics stores: Offer a phone case and charger together with the phone, plus a warranty at checkout.
  • Clothing stores: Show matching belts, socks, or bags with a jacket or shoes.
  • Beauty stores: Bundle a face wash and cream together at a discount.
  • Furniture stores: Offer paid setup help or delivery protection near the Add to Cart button.
  • Pet stores: Suggest toys, brushes, or treats along with pet food.
  • Pharmacy stores: Bundle vitamins together, or offer a pill box as a checkout order bump.
  • Sports stores: Bundle a yoga mat with a strap and water bottle.
  • Sweets and food stores: Group popular items into a discounted gift box.
  • Jewelry stores: Suggest matching earrings with a necklace.
  • Online course stores: Suggest a workbook or extra lesson along with the main course.
  • And many more: any WooCommerce store selling physical or digital products can use PickPair to show relevant offers.

Want to see everything before you install? Visit the features page or check the pricing page.
sections.installation:
What You Need

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Easy Install (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “PickPair”.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Open PickPair from your admin menu and create your first offer.

Manual Install

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from your account.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file you downloaded and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin, then open PickPair from your admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does PickPair work with the new WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks?

Yes. It works with both the old WooCommerce pages and the new Cart & Checkout Blocks, so your offers will show correctly no matter which one your store uses.

Will PickPair make my website slow?

No. PickPair only loads on the pages where an offer is actually shown, so the rest of your store — including checkout — stays fast.

Can I give a discount on bundles?

Yes. You can give a percentage discount, a fixed amount off, or set one fixed price for the whole bundle.

Can I choose which customers see an offer?

Yes. You can show offers based on specific products, categories, cart total, customer type, login status, or whether the customer has ordered before.

Can I add extra items like gift wrap or a warranty at checkout?

Yes. Checkout order bumps let customers add extras like gift wrap, a warranty, or fast shipping with one click before they pay. Product and Cart Add-ons work the same way earlier in the shopping process.

Can I send a coupon to bring customers back for their next order?

Yes. The Next Order Coupon feature sends a coupon automatically for the customer’s next purchase. You can set the expiry date, styling, and conditions yourself.

Can I see how much extra money PickPair has made me?

Yes. The built-in reports page shows total extra revenue, views, clicks, and sales for every offer, so you always know what is working.

Does PickPair work with caching plugins?

Yes. PickPair works smoothly with popular speed and caching plugins like WP Rocket and LiteSpeed Cache.

  • Added Campaign Analytics (reports).
  • Added support for WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.
  • Added fast, no-reload cart updates.
  • Added mobile-friendly design.
  • Added stock checks for bundled products.
